pro.label: Claude Pro
pro.summary: A Pro plan's weekly limit: one Claude worker, weekly stop at 80 %. Norn leaves room for your own sessions.

max-5x.label: Claude Max (5x)
max-5x.summary: A Max 5x plan's weekly limit: two Claude workers, weekly stop at 90 %.

max-20x.label: Claude Max (20x)
max-20x.summary: A Max 20x plan's weekly limit: three Claude workers, weekly stop at 95 %.

ultra.label: Claude Ultra
ultra.summary: An Ultra plan's weekly limit: four Claude workers, weekly stop at 95 %.

api.label: API billing (pay per token)
api.summary: No weekly limit: the weekly guard and the hourly rate cap are off and no calibration is needed. Spend is the Claude CLI's cost of each run; set a daily cap in $ to stop new Claude work past it.
